record.short: Automations per base cap raised from a flat 50 to 75 on Free, 100 on Team, 150 on Business and 200 on Enterprise Scale.
record.headline: Airtable replaced its flat cap of 50 automations per base with a tiered cap: 75 on Free, 100 on Team, 150 on Business and 200 on Enterprise Scale.
record.who: All Airtable plans; paid plans gain the most headroom.
record.read: The tiered caps are looser than the flat 50 on every plan, and paying plans get a bigger allowance than Free. A cap that was only just introduced and then relaxed looks like a correction after the flat limit proved too tight for paying teams.
record.caveat: The flat 50 cap was itself new: PricingSaaS shows it first on Sep 26 and again on Sep 28, so customers had it for only days. No pre-cap allowance is shown.

record.headline: Intercom’s pricing page showed the Essential seat at $19 a month instead of $29, while Advanced ($85) and Expert ($132) stayed the same.
record.who: Essential plan seats; the page does not say whether existing customers get the lower price.
record.read: A 34% cut on the entry plan while the higher plans hold looks aimed at winning smaller teams, though the short life of the price points to experimentation.
record.caveat: PricingSaaS later reported Essential back at $29 for most visitors on Oct 3, with some still seeing $19, which looks like a pricing test rather than a settled cut.

record.short: LLM Observability retention add-ons up: 30-day $1.50 → $6.50, 60-day $3 → $8, 90-day $4 → $9 per 10K spans a month.
record.headline: Datadog raised the price of all three extended-retention add-ons for LLM Observability, with the 30-day add-on more than quadrupling from $1.50 to $6.50 per 10K spans a month.
record.who: Customers buying extended retention for LLM Observability spans; the base plans are not affected.
record.read: The steepest rise is on the shortest add-on, so the three retention options now sit much closer together in price. That makes longer retention comparatively cheap and pushes users who relied on the cheap 30-day option towards a bigger bill.
